fishing: WHEN: Thursday morning Oct 8. Boca Grande low 5:23a, high 11:53a, low 5:52p. Best window about 7:38-9:38a on moving water. SE 5-10 kt becoming S, light chop, rain about 80%, storms later — run the pass before early afternoon. PASSES-BEACH: Fishin Franks 10/02 Stump Pass, Blind Pass Beach and Boca Grande — baby black drum, whiting, small snook, overslot redfish, ladyfish to 30 inches. Mornings and evenings best. Guides this week still have redfish schools thick with snook and snapper mixed in. LEMON BAY: docks and mangroves holding mangrove snapper, small black drum, redfish and snook; Chadwick pier some snapper; snook moving into the ICW. NEARSHORE: fall school bite — redfish, snook, mangrove snapper and trout; some sharks as water cools. Capt. Mike / Manasota Key Outfitters last posted report still June; no October bite note. Baits: live shrimp, cut bait, pinfish, gold spoons, topwater on the reds.
redtide: FWC Oct 2: K. brevis background only in SWFL (Sarasota samples); Charlotte Harbor samples through Oct 5 background, none detected. No fish kills. Next report Oct 9.
bacteria: Manasota Key Beach GOOD, no advisory — enterococci 10 on 10/5 (Healthy Beaches, page updated 10/8). Englewood Beach GOOD, last listed 20 CFU, no advisory.
